properties.title: Bosnia awaits for final general election results as preliminary count remains unclear
properties.summary: Around 3.4 million eligible voters in Bosnia headed to the polls to choose the three members of the country’s multi-ethnic presidency, lawmakers for the national Parliament, and heads of institutions for the country’s two entities.

properties.title: Azerbaijan, Turkey and Uzbekistan join forces in major military exercise
properties.summary: Thousands of military personnel from Azerbaijan, Turkey and Uzbekistan, as well as other nations participating as observers, including Iran, joined forces in the “Power of Unity, 2026” military exercise for the first time, in the Hojavend district of Azerbaijan’s Karabakh region.
